objective.primary: exact frozen held-fit 44b6 adjusted edge Jaccard delta versus the identical APNCC graph

governing_lesson: Change as little of the incumbent as possible: local node-disjoint swaps beat global re-solves and broad cost changes. This realization never rescales, reranks, or re-solves the full action pool.

named_mechanism.description: Apodized 3-D phase-correlation residual displacement between coordinate-centered multi-frame APNCC tracklet templates, used only as conservative evidence for a complete occupied-endpoint swap.
named_mechanism.distinct_from_dead_mechanisms: This is raw-appearance phase evidence inside already occupied conflicts, not geometry/NCC/constant-velocity shell abstention, not a graph-cost bonus, and not a full-cost replacement.
named_mechanism.alpha_reason: The cross-disciplinary transfer is subvoxel image registration used as an abstaining identity witness inside a frozen assignment conflict; the graph edit remains the minimal legal local swap.
named_mechanism.crowding_verdict: few: the defensible element is the joint restriction to multi-frame raw-3D phase residuals, incumbent-relative evidence, strict node-disjoint ownership, and a sealed tiny edit budget

grouped_folds.selection_folds: the already frozen five-way video hash fold carried by the exact occupied-swap population

population_and_firewall.candidate_population: all and only the 45,961 frozen N1-valid 44b6 occupied-endpoint swap actions
forbidden: whole action population scoring or reranking
held label in any phase feature
population_and_firewall.feature_inputs: read-only raw intensity, APNCC graph topology, node coordinates, and frozen candidate/conflict identities only
population_and_firewall.selection_labels: allowed only in the four outer training folds; the held fold is sealed until its threshold and scaled budget are fixed

phase_feature.normalization: per-video raw q0.01/q0.99 clipping mapped to [0,1]
phase_feature.tracklet: source endpoint plus at most two unique consecutive APNCC predecessors; destination endpoint plus at most two unique consecutive non-division APNCC successors
phase_feature.template: voxelwise median of each available side's coordinate-centered crops
phase_feature.phase_correlation: float64 FFT normalized cross-power with denominator floor 1e-12, inverse FFT, C-order/lexicographic peak tie break, wrapped three-point parabolic subvoxel refinement clipped to [-0.5,0.5] voxel
phase_feature.action_margin: candidate edge quality minus the maximum quality among all incumbent conflict edges removed by that exact swap

sealed_nested_selection.budget_scaling: round global budget by the fraction of the 36 videos in the training or held partition, with a minimum of one when the partition is nonempty
sealed_nested_selection.ranking: descending action_margin, descending candidate edge quality, then video index/source id/target id
sealed_nested_selection.node_disjointness: greedily reject an action if any candidate endpoint or any endpoint of any removed incumbent conflict edge was touched by an earlier accepted action in that video
sealed_nested_selection.choice_rule: on each four-fold training partition maximize exact adjusted graph delta among eligible configurations; tie break by fewer applied edits, lower global budget, higher margin/ratio/peak thresholds, and lower shift ceiling; seal that configuration before opening the held fold
sealed_nested_selection.final_edit_set: union of the five held-fold-only selections; no final threshold is refit on all folds

null_and_gates.null: no outer fold has an eligible training configuration, or the sealed OOF union is APNCC-identical, giving exact delta [0,0,0]
null_and_gates.scientific_kill: KILL_44B6 if the final exact adjusted delta is <=0, raw delta is <0, node recall delta is <0, or edit count is zero; this is the required cannot-beat-APNCC stop
null_and_gates.campaign_actionability: the unchanged stronger campaign gate additionally requires adjusted delta >=+0.005 with raw and node deltas nonnegative
null_and_gates.downstream: never run 6bba or CV57 unless the locked campaign gate explicitly opens; this lane stops at 44b6 either way
null_and_gates.apncc_comparison: report exact candidate and APNCC adjusted/raw/node vector and the difference
null_and_gates.edit_reporting: report proposed threshold-pass count, node-disjoint applied edit count, affected videos, oracle correct/harmful counts as postselection diagnostics, and compiler receipts

four_property_sieve.appearance_grounded: must use raw-intensity 3-D phase features; otherwise fail
four_property_sieve.narrow: occupied-conflict population only and final applied edits <=64; otherwise fail
four_property_sieve.node_disjoint: strict touched-node ownership and frozen N1 compiler replay; otherwise fail
four_property_sieve.recall_preserving: swap-only replacement, identical node set, and nonnegative exact raw/node graph deltas; otherwise fail

literature_grounding.citation: Guizar-Sicairos, Thurman, and Fienup, Optics Letters 33 (2008) 156-158
literature_grounding.scope: subpixel image registration only; no claim of biological identity or graph gain
